VERSION 3.28.0.172
; qMarkable sleep screen (reMarkable Paper Pure).
;
; Draws a quote, the date, today's study time and the last 7 days on top of
; the stock sleep screen. The stock contact details are kept and stay above
; this layer: at the bottom with the case open, and in the rotated strip on
; the right edge when the folio case is closed (so they show through the case).
;
; Data comes from qmarkable-trackerd (index.txt), read when the tablet goes to
; sleep. Edit qmSleepQuote below to change the quote.
;
; Requires: xovi + qt-resource-rebuilder. Firmware 3.28.0.172.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/sleepscreen/qml/tatsu/sleep-window-opaque.qml
    TRAVERSE BaseView#root > InputBlocker:contentItem

        ; above the stock logo/illustration, below the contact details
        LOCATE BEFORE ColumnLayout
        INSERT {
            Rectangle {
                id: qmSleep
                anchors.fill: parent
                color: "white"

                readonly property string qmSleepQuote: "per aspera ad astra"
                readonly property string mono: "Noto Sans Mono"
                readonly property var shades: ["#ffffff", "#d4d4d4", "#a0a0a0", "#5a5a5a", "#000000"]
                // keep clear of the right-edge contact strip (case closed)
                // and the bottom contact lines (case open)
                readonly property int sideMargin: 200

                property int todaySecs: 0
                property var week: []
                property string dateText: ""

                function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : "" + n; }
                function fmt(secs) {
                    var m = Math.round((secs || 0) / 60);
                    if (m < 60) return m + "m";
                    return Math.floor(m / 60) + "h " + pad(m % 60) + "m";
                }
                function level(secs) {
                    var m = (secs || 0) / 60;
                    if (m < 1) return 0;
                    if (m < 30) return 1;
                    if (m < 60) return 2;
                    if (m < 120) return 3;
                    return 4;
                }
                function keyOf(ms) {
                    var d = new Date(ms);
                    return d.getUTCFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getUTCDate());
                }

                function load() {
                    // synchronous read: the screen is drawn once, right now
                    var text = "";
                    try {
                        var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
                        x.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.local/share/qmarkable/index.txt", false);
                        x.send();
                        text = x.responseText || "";
                    } catch (e) {
                        text = "";
                    }
                    var tot = {};
                    var off = -new Date().getTimezoneOffset();
                    var lines = text.split("\n");
                    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                        var line = lines[i];
                        if (line.indexOf("#") === 0) {
                            var at = line.indexOf("tzoff=");
                            if (at >= 0) off = parseInt(line.substring(at + 6), 10);
                            continue;
                        }
                        var p = line.split(" ");
                        if (p.length >= 2 && p[0].length === 10) tot[p[0]] = parseInt(p[1], 10);
                    }
                    var local = new Date(Date.now() + off * 60000);
                    var mid = Date.UTC(local.getUTCFullYear(), local.getUTCMonth(), local.getUTCDate());
                    var names = ["sun", "mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat"];
                    var w = [];
                    for (var d = 6; d >= 0; d--) {
                        var ms = mid - d * 86400000;
                        var k = keyOf(ms);
                        w.push({ letter: names[new Date(ms).getUTCDay()].charAt(0), secs: tot[k] || 0, today: d === 0 });
                    }
                    week = w;
                    todaySecs = tot[keyOf(mid)] || 0;
                    dateText = keyOf(mid) + "  " + names[local.getUTCDay()];
                }

                Component.onCompleted: load()
                onVisibleChanged: { if (visible) load(); }

                Column {
                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    anchors.verticalCenterOffset: -60
                    width: parent.width - 2 * qmSleep.sideMargin
                    spacing: 0

                    Text {
                        width: parent.width
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                        text: qmSleep.qmSleepQuote
                        font.family: "EB Garamond"
                        font.italic: true
                        font.pixelSize: 96
                        color: "black"
                    }

                    Item { width: 1; height: 72 }

                    Text {
                        width: parent.width
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        text: qmSleep.dateText
                        font.family: qmSleep.mono
                        font.pixelSize: 26
                        color: "#8c8c8c"
                    }

                    Item { width: 1; height: 14 }

                    Text {
                        width: parent.width
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        text: "today  " + qmSleep.fmt(qmSleep.todaySecs)
                        font.family: qmSleep.mono
                        font.pixelSize: 40
                        font.bold: true
                        color: "black"
                    }

                    Item { width: 1; height: 44 }

                    // last 7 days, ending today
                    Row {
                        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                        spacing: 14
                        Repeater {
                            model: qmSleep.week
                            delegate: Column {
                                spacing: 10
                                Rectangle {
                                    width: 56
                                    height: 56
                                    color: qmSleep.shades[qmSleep.level(modelData.secs)]
                                    border.width: qmSleep.level(modelData.secs) === 0 ? 1 : 0
                                    border.color: "#b4b4b4"
                                    Rectangle {
                                        // today: small inner square, as on the homepage
                                        visible: modelData.today
                                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                                        width: 14
                                        height: 14
                                        color: qmSleep.level(modelData.secs) >= 3 ? "white" : "black"
                                    }
                                }
                                Text {
                                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                                    text: modelData.letter
                                    font.family: qmSleep.mono
                                    font.pixelSize: 22
                                    color: "#8c8c8c"
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        ; our layer replaces the stock "reMarkable is sleeping" fallback,
        ; which would otherwise cover everything when no logo image loads
        TRAVERSE Rectangle#errorPlaceholder
            REPLACE visible WITH {
                visible: false
            }
        END TRAVERSE

    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
